bullets.title: Goldman adds MSFT to Conviction Buy, drops AVGO
bullets.body: Goldman Sachs refreshed its U.S. Conviction List, adding Microsoft and removing Broadcom. The move signals a rotation in Goldman's highest-conviction tech bets heading into earnings season.

bullets.title: Mag 7 premarket: AMZN +1.6% on fifth straight quarter of cloud acceleration
bullets.body: Amazon rose 1.6% premarket on its fifth consecutive quarter of cloud revenue acceleration. GOOGL +1.7%, MSFT +1.8%, META +1.6%, and TSLA +0.6% also gained, with the group broadly higher heading into the open.

bullets.title: TSLA Europe July registrations sharply mixed; Stifel cuts PT to $491
bullets.body: Tesla's July European registrations showed extreme dispersion: +86% in France and +52% in Denmark, but -97% in Norway, -81% in Spain, and -60% in Sweden. Stifel maintained its Buy but cut the price target to $491 from $508, citing Q2 gross margin of 16.8% and missed adjusted EBITDA; a bull-side note argues July's weakness reflects Tesla's normal end-of-quarter delivery wave, with September historically running at multiples of July volumes.

bullets.title: Alibaba launches Qwen3.8-Max, claims parity with Anthropic Claude Fable 5
bullets.body: Alibaba released Qwen3.8-Max, positioning it as competitive with Anthropic's Claude Fable 5 for coding and collaborative tasks. BABA has rallied 35% since one fintwit call flagged the bottom, alongside JD +31%.

bullets.title: AI inference costs collapsing; Goldman margin outlook seen as too optimistic
bullets.body: Token/inference costs are plunging to early-2026 levels despite 'relentless demand' for agentic AI, driven by Chinese competition. One widely-cited fintwit post argues Goldman Sachs' margin outlook for AI-exposed names appears too optimistic given the pricing pressure.

bullets.title: Fed's Williams backs current stance; open to hikes if inflation stalls
bullets.body: NY Fed President Williams 'strongly' supported last week's FOMC decision and reaffirmed the reaction function, expecting inflation to decline in H2 and further in 2026—but said the Fed will act if inflation doesn't fall as expected. Williams also said AI sector volatility is unsurprising and sees no financial stability risks from elevated AI investment.

bullets.title: BNP forecasts three Fed hikes starting December; Goldman warns on reduced guidance
bullets.body: BNP Paribas expects U.S. Treasury yields to rise as markets price in three Fed rate hikes beginning December, with investors questioning Fed credibility. Goldman separately cautioned that reducing forward guidance could increase market volatility and pricing errors.

bullets.title: BofA likens Warsh nomination to an emerging-market credibility shock
bullets.body: Bank of America characterized the market's reaction to Kevin Warsh as resembling an emerging-market credibility shock dynamic, a framing flagged as a 'key take' by multiple fintwit accounts.

bullets.title: Neil Dutta labels current environment 'stagflation-lite'
bullets.body: Renaissance Macro economist Neil Dutta coined the term 'stagflation-lite' for present conditions, stopping short of full stagflation while flagging the simultaneous growth and inflation pressure. The framing is gaining traction in macro fintwit circles.

bullets.title: U.S.-Japan coordinate first joint yen intervention since 1998; BOJ deployed ~¥5.3T
bullets.body: BOJ data suggest Japan intervened with approximately 5.3 trillion yen on Friday. The U.S. joined in what is being described as the first coordinated yen-buying effort since 1998, aimed at stabilizing the currency and reducing the risk of Japan selling U.S. Treasuries to fund support. JPMorgan cautions the U.S. Treasury now has limited liquid resources for further intervention.

bullets.title: Japan 2-year yield hits 30-year high above 1.57%; yen decoupled from rates since April
bullets.body: Japan's 2-year yield surged above 1.57%, its highest level in over 30 years, signaling persistent monetary tightening pressure. Separately, one fintwit chart noted the yen stopped tracking interest rate differentials after April 2025, complicating the conventional carry-trade framework.

bullets.title: S&P 500 Q2 earnings beat rate at record high per Deutsche Bank
bullets.body: Deutsche Bank data show the proportion of S&P 500 companies beating Q2 earnings estimates is at a record high. EPS is also flagged as trading at historically elevated levels relative to trend for the first time since 1955.

bullets.title: Warren Buffett Indicator hits 241%, exceeding Dot Com and GFC peaks
bullets.body: The market-cap-to-GDP ratio ('Buffett Indicator') reached 241%, surpassing levels seen during the Dot Com bubble, the 2008 financial crisis, and the 2022 bear market—flagged as the most expensive valuation in history.

bullets.title: Strait of Hormuz remains active but tense; Iran denies U.S. talks, downs MQ-9
bullets.body: Iran denied any negotiations with the U.S. and claimed to have shot down an MQ-9 drone in the Strait of Hormuz. Hormuz crossings were limited to 9 on Aug 2, though 3–5M barrels/day continue flowing through the southern Persian Gulf shipping lane. Iran is instead in talks with Oman over a separate shipping arrangement.

bullets.title: FCC restricts foreign robot imports; Morgan Stanley sees limited near-term impact on China makers
bullets.body: The FCC will restrict imports of certain foreign-made advanced robots including humanoids, quadrupeds, and autonomous devices. Morgan Stanley expects limited near-term impact on Chinese humanoid robot makers as existing FCC-approved devices appear grandfathered in.

bullets.title: MSTR sold 1,637 BTC last week, reducing holdings to 842,138 BTC
bullets.body: Strategy (MicroStrategy) filed disclosures showing it sold 1,637 Bitcoin over the past week, bringing total holdings to 842,138 BTC—a notable reversal from its accumulation posture.

bullets.title: UK gilt yields drop 10bps to 4.95% on broad bond strength
bullets.body: UK 10-year gilt yields fell 10 basis points to 4.95%, extending gains on broad bond market strength. The move comes as political uncertainty around a potential new King's Speech adds to the macro backdrop.

bullets.title: 30-year Treasury yield down 5bps but remains elevated after spiking to 5.28%; T-bond vol breaks out
bullets.body: The 30-year Treasury yield eased 5bps on oil weakness but remains elevated following last week's spike to 5.28%. T-bond volatility confirmed a 'big-time' breakout on Friday, per Hedgeye's McCullough.

bullets.title: SPY confirmed bullish trade and trend on elevated summer Friday volume
bullets.body: Hedgeye flagged that volume accelerated on a summer Friday, confirming SPY as both a bullish trade and bullish trend signal. The 30-year yield and oil dynamics are being watched as key macro overlays.

bullets.title: JP Morgan initiates RBLX with Neutral at $40 PT; AMZN PT raised to $325
bullets.body: JP Morgan assumed coverage of Roblox with a Neutral rating and $40 price target. Separately, Roth MKM raised its Amazon price target to $325 from $300.
